composition_placeholder: Rule of thirds, centered, cinematic framing...
confirm_batch_delete_scenes:
Delete {n} selected scenes?
Related dialogues and assets will also be deleted. This cannot be undone.
confirm_batch_generate:
Batch generate {kind} for {n} selected scenes?
Non-eligible scenes will be skipped automatically.

{total} scenes selected: {existing} already have scene images, {missing} not generated yet.
Continuing will generate new candidate images for all selected scenes; existing images are kept, and the new image is auto-selected once ready.
confirm_duplicate_scene: Are you sure to duplicate this scene?
confirm_insert_scene: Insert a new scene here? (AI will generate the scene content)
doodle_clear_confirm: Clear all doodles? You can restore them with undo.
doodle_exit_confirm: Your doodles will be lost if you close without confirming.
hint_act_grid_first_frames: Generate first frames per act with 2×2/3×3 grids
hint_at_insert_asset: Tip: type @ to insert a character or prop
hint_audio_source_exclusive: Video audio and dialogue voiceover never play together
hint_auto_duration: Auto picks the closest tier not shorter than the scene duration (incl. voiceover); MiniMax lip-sync is clamped to 4–10s
hint_char_missing_reference: No reference image; this character's reference is skipped when generating scene images
hint_char_not_in_library: Not in the character library; its reference will be skipped when generating scene images
hint_char_not_in_library_detail: Not in the character library; its reference image will be skipped. Create or rename it in Character Management first
hint_char_variant: (Detects outfit/transform changes, generates new character looks; used automatically in scene image generation)
hint_clip_to_audio: When on, exports clip the video to the voiceover (scene) duration; when off, the full video is exported
hint_community_sequential_first_frames: Community edition generates first frames scene by scene
hint_dh_single_character_only: Lip-sync mode supports only a single speaking character
hint_dh_single_voiceover: Generate a lip-sync video from a single character's voiceover
hint_dh_voice_generating: Voiceover for this lip-sync scene is generating; the MiniMax H3 Digital Human video can be generated once done
hint_dh_voice_ready: Voiceover is ready; you can generate the MiniMax H3 Digital Human video
hint_dh_voice_required: Lip-sync scene: generate the voiceover in the Dialogue tab first, then the MiniMax H3 Digital Human video
hint_dialogue_model: Used for dialogue editing and other LLM features once selected
hint_emo_ai_auto_suffix: edition can infer emotion vectors with AI during script splitting and apply them in auto voiceover.
hint_emo_ai_enabled: Enterprise capability enabled: AI can fill emotion vectors for lines during script splitting.
hint_emo_manual_note: Note: everyone can view and edit manually. Only the
hint_emo_vec_ctrl: Controls the emotional tone of the voiceover for this line (8 dims, total ≤
hint_emo_vec_save: After saving, Generate Voiceover submits with this vector (Enterprise only).
hint_enterprise_only: This is a PRO feature; please purchase the PRO edition to use it
hint_episode_auto_create: A storyboard is created automatically if missing; episodes with scripts are linked automatically.
hint_existing_kept_candidates: ; existing images are kept as candidates
hint_first_frame_duration: First-frame mode: shots and groups stay within this duration; longer ones split within the same scene
hint_first_frame_mode: Generate scene images first, then videos; shots are split by composition
hint_first_last_frames: The 1st image is the first frame; the 2nd can be the last frame
hint_generate_first_frames_first: Generate scene first frames before batch video generation
hint_i2v_input: Used with first frame or first/last frame input; lip-sync Digital Human also uses this resolution preference
hint_i2v_model: Generates videos when the scene has a first frame; lists only first/last-frame models
hint_i2v_resolution_map: Follows the current Image-to-Video model; MiniMax lip-sync maps to the longest side (480P→720 / 720P→1280 / 1080P→1920)
hint_image_batch_active: A scene image generation task is already running
hint_lip_sync_need_audio_first: Lip-sync scenes need dialogue audio before batch video generation
hint_missing_ref_queue_paused: missing reference images; the upcoming scene queue has not started
hint_model_config_apply: Selections apply automatically to the assistant's current mode
hint_multi_reference_mode: Skip scene images and generate from character/scene/prop references; an existing scene image is also used as the main reference. @首帧图 or @尾帧图 in the prompt places the configured frames at the ends of the reference list
hint_no_dialogue_use_video_audio: No dialogue voiceover yet; the video's own audio is used. It switches back to dialogue voiceover automatically once generated.
hint_no_image_input: Used when there is no image input
hint_no_reference: Used when there is no reference image
hint_no_video_no_audio_generate_first: No video or dialogue voiceover yet; generate one to preview.
hint_no_video_no_audio_preview_later: This scene has no video or dialogue voiceover yet; generate to preview.
hint_no_video_temp_dialogue_audio: No video yet; until one is generated, continuous preview and export use the dialogue voiceover below.
hint_qc_rounds: Split→QC loops up to N times; if it still fails, the last round is adopted to avoid a dead end
hint_ref_duration: Reference mode: each scene targets this duration; shots split only when merging the next beat would exceed it (never across scenes/acts)
hint_ref_resolution: Reference-mode video resolution; follows the reference video model above
hint_ref_video_model: Reference-mode videos use this model; shots use its max supported duration when possible
hint_reference_mode: No scene images; each shot fills the model's max duration and splits only when the next would exceed it
hint_reference_video_model: Used for multi-reference, reference audio/video, or first/last frame plus reference
hint_replacing_voice_progress: Extracting audio and replacing the character voice; switches to the new video automatically when done
hint_scene_ref_not_ready: Scene reference images are not ready yet
hint_scene_video_resolution: Resolution preference for scene videos; follows the image-to-video model above
hint_split_first_frame_mode: First-frame mode: auto-fills scene images after splitting, then generates videos from them
hint_split_model: Splits the script into scenes, image prompts and dialogue data
hint_split_reference_mode: Reference mode: no auto first-frame fill; batch-generates videos directly from character/scene/prop references
hint_style_affects_all: Changes apply to every scene image in this storyboard.
hint_subtitle_sample: Sample subtitle for side-margin preview — drag the sliders to adjust the padding on both sides in real time
hint_subtitle_settings: Per line: subtitles follow the voiceover timeline. Margins are the subtitle insets in exported videos and can be previewed live.
hint_switch_keeps_videos: Existing videos are kept after switching
hint_total_duration: Caps total scenes duration: prefers the script-declared duration, else estimates from dialogue (reading rate ÷ dialogue share); N× = base × N
hint_upload_reference_with_assets: Upload a reference; character/scene/prop references are used when none uploaded. Slots fill as first frame, last frame, then references
hint_video_audio_track_used: Continuous preview and full export use the video's own audio track instead of the dialogue voiceover below.
hint_video_multi_reference_ok: (Multi-reference: skip scene images and use character/location/prop reference images)
hint_video_multi_reference_unsupported: (Current model does not support multi-reference; first/last frame mode will be used)
hint_video_muted_use_dialogue_audio: The video stays muted; continuous preview and full export use the dialogue voiceover below in order.
hint_wechat_pay_scan: Open WeChat "Scan" to complete the payment
hint_wechat_pay_wait: If already paid, please wait; credits arrive automatically
hint_will_use_asset_references: Character/scene/prop references of this scene will be used
hint_with_reference: Used with reference images or for image edits
mode_balanced_desc: Balances speed and scene quality — a compromise of both.
mode_quality_desc: Built for long-form narrative: locks scene, lighting and character consistency for cinematic shots.
mode_speed_desc: Splits scripts fast — great for draft previews and dry runs.
